title: 读取公开 GitHub 仓库基本资料
program: const parts = input.repository.split("/"); if (parts.length !== 2 || parts.some(part => !part.length || part === "." || part === "..")) return {status:"failure",reason:"Expected owner/repository"}; const path = "/repos/" + parts.map(encodeURIComponent).join("/"); const page = await tools.read_json({path}); if (page.status !== "success") return page; const value = page.value; if (value.found === false && value.status === 404) return {status:"success",value:{found:false}}; if (typeof value.full_name !== "string" || typeof value.html_url !== "string" || typeof value.default_branch !== "string") return {status:"uncertain",reason:"Repository response schema changed; ask research assistance"}; return {status:"success",value:{found:true,fullName:value.full_name,pageURL:value.html_url,defaultBranch:value.default_branch}};
